notes.title: Update 0.6.6
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] ​Added a Certified Creator system.​​ Upon becoming a Certified Creator, users can publish challenge levels in Community Challenges. Certified Creators will have a Creator badge displayed next to their name.
[*] ​Streamlined the process for Instructors to create and submit courses for review.​​ Instructors can now publish their created courses more conveniently. Users with Instructor status will have an Instructor badge displayed next to their name.
[*] ​Added new training courses to the official Growth Path:​​ Training courses for Knife-edge Flight and Landing Practice have been included.
[*] ​Enhanced the Visual Flight Reference (VFR) system.​​ A 3-axis orientation indicator will now automatically appear when the aircraft flies a significant distance away to help determine its attitude.
[*] ​Reduced the intensity of touch-and-go flip physics upon crash impact.​​
[*] ​Added a Virtual Gate component to the track objects library.​​ This eliminates the previous need for using transparent gates to visually smooth track curves.
[*] ​Added Offset Coefficients to the Remote Controller Calibration process.​​ If the controller's physical center point does not align with the origin of the coordinate system after calibration, these coefficients can be adjusted to make the controller's center point coincide with the coordinate system origin.
[*] ​Significantly optimized the performance of Workshop X.​​ It now runs smoothly even when displaying highly complex, structure-intensive blueprint objects.
[/list]

notes.title: Version Update 0.6.3
notes.notes:
Update Content:
  - The image quality has been improved. The rendering quality issue has been fixed without consuming additional performance, bringing the visual level up to the expected standard.
  - The distortion effect has been temporarily disabled and will be implemented with a better method in the next version.
  - The layout of the settings interface has been adjusted, separating the aircraft parameters and RATE values into two separate pages.
  - A dynamic effect has been added to the RATE value adjustment interface, allowing you to see the real-time relationship between the stick input and RATE values.
  - The layout of the aircraft parameters interface has been modified, reducing the number of default aircraft to make more space for custom aircraft.
  - A one-click import/export function for aircraft parameters and RATE values has been provided. You can now import data from experts with a single click and export your well-tuned data to share with friends.
  - Known issues in the X Workshop have been fixed. The UI of the Growth Path has been adjusted, and all level data have been updated, preparing for the upcoming expansion features.

notes.title: 0.6.2.36 Update | Upgraded Flight Experience and Expanded Scene Build Feature
notes.notes:
Update Content:
- Added flight demonstrations in the Growth Path. Users can watch the flight demonstrations to understand the details of stick control and aircraft attitude, and can also pause and watch frame by frame.
- Added apron components in X Workshop.
- Added building elements in X Workshop, which can be used to build more complex and interesting scenes.
- The scene will not be reloaded when resetting a level, greatly speeding up the restart and not interrupting the flight flow experience.
- The sound effects have been comprehensively improved.
- The feel of the 5-inch flower plane (thanks to THEMODE_FPV) and the trainer (thanks to FREEFALLALL) has been adjusted.
- A switch to display propellers has been added in the application settings.
- The issue of being unable to enter the game after a long period of inactivity has been fixed.
- A preview button has been added to the sound playback component in X Workshop.
- A button to no longer display has been added in the text component. If this option is checked, the text prompt will not be displayed when resetting the level.
- The issue of incorrect bf rate value calculation in some special cases has been fixed.
- The upper limit of the ac rate has been removed, and the maximum value can be set to 2000.
